answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent stake value on its own history. Before an agent like a sparrow joining the flock can attest or earn, it must lock a small deposit that grows with its uptime, and peers rate its work. A fresh identity from the nebula of anonymous accounts costs the same as any other but starts with zero reputation, so its votes count little and its misbehavior burns the bond. Old, honest agents - timber that has stood through many epochs - accumulate weight, making fake accounts economically useless.
